content:
A Chinese leaker with a track record has recently uploaded several images claiming to be the circuit diagrams of the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro.

The images suggest the new A20 Pro chip may feature seven GPU cores—one more than the previous generation—along with a faster memory interface……

The images uploaded by Weibo user 「炒白飯」 are not actually the A20 Pro chip itself, but schematic diagrams showing the chip's soldering position on the underlying circuit board. Based on these images, they inferred the new chip's performance and architecture, arriving at two main conclusions about possible improvements.

Firstly, the images show the CPU also in a six-core configuration, the same as last year's model: two high-performance cores plus four efficiency cores. However, the efficiency cores appear to have increased cache memory.

Based solely on the limited information provided by the soldering diagram, it is difficult to determine the number of GPU cores—six, seven or even eight are all possible. However, they believe seven cores is the most likely.

Fixed Focus Digital earlier pointed out that the A20 Pro chip would be 18% faster than its predecessor, with a 30% improvement in power efficiency.

9to5Mac's take

The Weibo account does have some credibility, but this kind of indirect inference is really a guessing game. Although their conclusions sound reasonable, readers should treat them as informed speculation rather than established fact.
